title: Nine Words of Making
subtitle: 选择与抉择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 选择与抉择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：选择与抉择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：choice　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 choice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to make ① choice she could not undo, and she said the making was the whole of the lesson. The ② choice, meaning the decision and not the menu, was nine words long and was made by whoever came last; choice, she said, is the only thing in a life that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ choice in that life had the same cost, and the ④ choice at the end, meaning the one the father kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever made properly. Choice, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ choice was the whole of the year, meaning the freedom it carried and not the decision. The ⑥ choice, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody wants and nobody questions; choice, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a decision and a freedom. She said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ choice had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the cost. The ⑧ choice of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine words and eleven years of making; choice, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ choice I remember is the one at the end, which was made in 1971 and is still described as the bravest in the county. A ⑩ choice, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being made; every choice, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a decision. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 选择（指那个决定本身，与那份菜单相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a choice 作出一个选择
D. n. 选择（指那一生中每一个）
E. n. 选择（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 选择权（抽象：它承载的那份自由）
G. n. 那份自由（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The choice, meaning the decision and not the menu
choice was the whole of the year
the choice had become a number in a report
The choice of the whole thing
A choice, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: make a choice 意为“作出一个选择”，1951 年母亲被派去作出她无法撤销的那个选择。
choice 意为“选择、抉择”，指那个决定本身而不是那份菜单，共九个词，由最后来的人作出。
choice 指那一生中每一个选择，每一个都是同样的代价。
choice 指末尾那一个（父亲保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真作出过的。
choice 意为“选择权”，抽象指它承载的那份自由，父亲说 choice 就是那一年的全部。
choice 为抽象用法，指那份自由本身，是一年里人人都想要、却没人质疑的东西。
choice 意为“选择、抉择”，到 1966 年这个 choice 成了报告里的一个数字。
choice 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个词和十一年的抉择。
choice 意为“选择”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1971 年作出，至今仍被说成全县最勇敢的。
choice 为抽象总称，祖母说一个选择是唯一会因为被认真作出而变好的东西。
